findings.title: setUTCMonth overflows on month-end anchors (regression)
findings.explanation: setUTCMonth does not clamp the day. It only handles month and year rollover. It does not clamp the day of the month. For a periodStart of Jan 31, setUTCMonth(1) gives Feb 31, which normalizes to Mar 3 (or Mar 2 in a leap year). The same happens for Mar 31 -> Apr 31 -> May 1, Aug 31 -> Sep 31 -> Oct 1, and so on. The removed code explicitly clamped to the last day of the next month, as its deleted comment said (Jan 31 -> Feb 28/29). This change silently breaks that behavior, so customers anchored on the 29th, 30th or 31st would get billing periods that are too long and have drifting renewal dates. This is a billing correctness bug. Keep the clamping: compute the last day of the target month with Date.UTC(year, month + 2, 0) and use Math.min(anchorDay, lastDay), or set the date to 1 first, set the month, then set the date to the clamped day. The PR description's claim that setUTCMonth already handles this is incorrect.

findings.title: No test covering month-end edge cases
findings.explanation: The refactor changed behavior without any test failing, which suggests there are no tests for end-of-month, leap-year or December->January rollover. Add table-driven tests for Jan 31, Jan 30, Jan 29 in leap and non-leap years, Mar 31, Aug 31 and Dec 31, plus a normal mid-month date. They should assert the exact expected end dates.

findings.title: Clamping comment removed along with the logic
findings.explanation: Even if the simplification were valid, the business rule (renew on the last day of a shorter month) is worth documenting. Keep a comment explaining the intended month-end behavior so a future refactor doesn't drop it again.

prompt:
Review this pull request.

## Simplify next billing period calculation

Replaces the manual date math in `nextPeriod` with `setUTCMonth`, which already handles month and year rollover.

## Diff

```diff
diff --git a/src/services/billing.ts b/src/services/billing.ts
index 81ad02d..eb1824d 100644
--- a/src/services/billing.ts
+++ b/src/services/billing.ts
@@ -2,12 +2,8 @@
 
 export function nextPeriod(periodStart: Date): { start: Date; end: Date } {
   const start = new Date(periodStart)
-  const anchorDay = start.getUTCDate()
-  const year = start.getUTCFullYear()
-  const month = start.getUTCMonth() + 1
-  // Clamp to the last day of the next month, so a period starting on Jan 31 renews on Feb 28/29.
-  const lastDayOfNextMonth = new Date(Date.UTC(year, month + 1, 0)).getUTCDate()
-  const end = new Date(Date.UTC(year, month, Math.min(anchorDay, lastDayOfNextMonth)))
+  const end = new Date(periodStart)
+  end.setUTCMonth(end.getUTCMonth() + 1)
   return { start, end }
 }
```
